title: Queue done refuses a check once the handover changed
what: `relay queue done` allows after the check exactly the files the gate treats as inert (docs/handover.md with .relay/), from one shared list.
why: The delegate skill says to commit the handover after the check, and the gate treats docs/handover.md as inert, but `relay queue done` refuses the check when any file outside .relay/ changed after it; closing needed the handover commit reverted and reapplied (core-tests-not-in-gate, 23 Oct).
failing_case: Check of 1a68931, then a commit to docs/handover.md, then `relay queue done ... --check <q1-check.json>` refuses at lib/relay_queue.py:755 "docs/handover.md changed after it: check the fix again".
pass_cases: After a handover-only commit `done` accepts the check; after a change to any non-inert file it still refuses.
